sections.heading: What is trending: “hiking”
paragraphs: “hiking” appeared on Google Trends' Trending Now list for MY (snapshot taken 2026-09-07T16:27:45+00:00 UTC). Google reports at least 500 searches for this term — that figure is a lower bound published in the official Trends feed, not an exact count.

sections.heading: What's behind the spike — the coverage
paragraphs: The Trends feed associates this search spike with 3 news stories from KPTV, San Francisco Chronicle, The Seattle Times. The headlines, exactly as published:

“Hikers who used AI to plan mountain trip had to be rescued, authorities say” — KPTV

sections.heading: Timeline

sections.heading: How to read these numbers
paragraphs: Google Trends reports approximate search volume as a lower bound (for example “20K+”). Actual volume can be significantly higher. Trending status reflects acceleration in searches, not the absolute size of a topic. For the full story behind the spike, read the cited coverage below — this briefing intentionally adds no speculation beyond the sourced facts.
